summary: Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5 16IMH9 System State Baseline
suggested_solution: Verify compatibility of Anker Prime 100W USB C Charger with device's power requirements.
Check compatibility of JSAUX 100W USB C to USB C Cable with device's power requirements and USB-C version.
Attempt charging using different power adapter, such as Lenovo 100W USB-C slim (3-pin) AC adapter.
